motion.reducedMotion: disable autoplay, drift and nonessential transforms

must: Preserve Patropi's deep green, cream and gold identity
Preserve real photography and editorial hospitality tone
Use the semantic tokens defined in tailwind.config.ts
avoid: Gold body text on cream backgrounds
Unnecessary pill shapes and heavy shadows

decisions.decision: Consolidate the existing palette into semantic aliases without changing the brand colors.
decisions.reason: Improve consistency while preserving the established identity.

decisions.decision: Keep Georgia/Times for display and Arial/Helvetica for interface and body copy.
decisions.reason: Typography family changes are outside the controlled foundation phase.

decisions.decision: Use three primary radii and two restrained elevation levels.
decisions.reason: Reduce visual drift and avoid floating SaaS-style cards.

decisions.decision: Use a contextual hero scale: primary editorial heroes progress from 44px to 80px, while compact internal heroes progress from 42px to 72px.
decisions.reason: Preserve the Patropi's editorial presence without letting headings dominate intermediate viewports.

decisions.decision: Keep one visually dominant action in each hero and render auxiliary route links with lower emphasis.
decisions.reason: Make the next step clear while preserving access to secondary destinations.

decisions.decision: Present small review sets as a static editorial composition instead of an infinite marquee.
decisions.reason: Keep every review visible and readable without duplicated content, clipped cards or decorative motion.

decisions.decision: Use divider-based information lists for hours, amenities and secondary contact channels; reserve filled containers for primary actions.
decisions.reason: Reduce template-like card repetition while preserving scanability and hierarchy.

decisions.decision: Keep the existing custom gallery lightbox and harden its dialog semantics, focus containment, focus restoration, background inertness and scroll locking.
decisions.reason: It already matches the visual language and can meet the interaction requirements without adding a new primitive or runtime dependency.

decisions.decision: Use restrained editorial motion and disable autoplay and nonessential transforms when reduced motion is requested.
decisions.reason: Preserve atmosphere without making movement compete with content or accessibility preferences.

decisions.decision: Use a custom accessible date-range calendar for hotel availability, presented as an anchored popover on desktop and a full-screen panel on mobile.
decisions.reason: Keep date selection touch-friendly, timezone-safe and visually integrated with the Patropi identity without adding a runtime dependency.

decisions.decision: Use a curated, category-driven photography catalog with editorial wide, portrait and featured placements.
decisions.reason: Show the new first-party hotel and restaurant collection without visual repetition, preserve intentional crops and keep the gallery performant.
